title: RGB stretch selects the wrong reference on tied channel totals
description:
indigo_libs/indigo_stretch.cpp:616-670 uses strict largest-channel comparisons. R=G>B selects B as reference; all-zero totals divide by zero. Select a stable maximal channel and handle zero totals explicitly. Verify tied maxima, black input and ordinary RGB24/RGB48 data. Source-confirmed, no runtime AWB test. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (CORE-AWB). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
